title: High RDS CPU on multiple environments

updates.body: We are investigating issues with Latency and 5xx errors for Jira, Jira Service Management, Jira Work Management due to High RDS CPU on several EU-Central environment and will provide updates here soon.
We’ve taken steps to address the issue by scaling up the RDS instances, and we will continue to monitor the systems to ensure everything remains stable.
We are observing different RDS problems in different environments for Jira, Jira Service Management, and Jira Work Management. We are actively working on this and will provide more updates here soon.

title: Slow loading times and extended response times for Cloud products in the EU-West region.

updates.body: We are investigating issues with slow loading and long responsive time for all products (Jira, JSM, JSW and Confluence) and will provide updates here soon.
Systems have recovered, and the issue has been mitigated. All affected products are fully operational, with no further impact observed.
